responsibility: This file implements GCC’s utilities for working with single-entry/single-exit (SESE) regions in GIMPLE CFGs, primarily for Graphite/scop-style region analyses and transformations. It builds and frees sese_info objects, computes region live-out SSA names and debug live-outs, inserts exit PHIs for values leaving a region, rewrites a region into an if/else-shaped control-flow shell for guarded generation, and provides predicates and helpers for region membership, loop containment, scalar-evolution queries, and invariance testing within a SESE. In practice it consumes CFG, SSA, loop, and scalar-evolution information and produces region bookkeeping and CFG/SSA edits needed by region-based optimizers.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file implements SESE-region operations declared in gcc/sese.h, such as building liveout sets, inserting exit PHIs, transforming a region into an if-shaped wrapper, scalar-evolution queries, and debug/printing routines, rather than defining the region data structures and inline predicates.
